grade.first_issue: The one-variable minimum classification omits the endpoint \(x=0\), which is also a one-sided local minimum; its positive value is only implicitly covered later by the boundary analysis.
grade.summary: The compactness, Lagrange-multiplier reduction, equal-variable analysis, and boundary argument correctly establish the inequality. The derivative sign analysis is terse but sufficient; the omitted endpoint check is minor and does not undermine the global conclusion.
strengths: Correctly reduces every interior critical point to a case with at least two equal variables.
The derivative structure shows that the symmetric point is the only interior local minimum on the equal-variable slice.
The boundary is correctly reduced to a concave one-variable function with positive endpoint values.

errors.description: The list of one-variable local minima omits \(x=0\), where \(f(0)=1\); this is repaired directly by the subsequent boundary computation.
